behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: A later explicit deny overrides an earlier wildcard grant.
Difference between * and terminal ** at zero and multiple remaining segments.
docDelivery: Wildcard segment grammar and action wildcard.
Deny precedence, default denial and deduplicated role explanation order.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Resource nonempty slash-separated segments [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+, no empty segments. Pattern same with whole-segment * and optional terminal **. Actions nonempty ASCII identifiers, pattern action may be *. Roles finite unique nonempty names; effects allow/deny.
independence: Integrate role grants, explicit resource denies and wildcard scope matching into authorization explanation.
